name: Quinoa Primavera with Lemony Salmon & Asparagus

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup quinoa
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
1 lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Cut the lemon in half; juice one half into a small bowl and cut the other half into four wedges for serving.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Place the salmon on a plate, drizzle with half of the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g salmon fillet
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the salmon skin-side-down in the skillet; cook until the flesh is opaque, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince the shallot; transfer to a small bowl.
Snap (or cut) off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears on an angle into 2-inch pieces.
Once the salmon has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet, then add the shallot. Cook, stirring frequently, until the shallot is softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the asparagus and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
While the asparagus cooks, shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Once cooked, remove the asparagus from the heat; stir in most of the parsley (save a little for garnishing) and drizzle with the remaining lemon juice.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork; add to the asparagus and stir to combine.

Divide the quinoa and asparagus mixture between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container), top with the salmon, and garnish with the remaining parsley. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over top. Enjoy!
